admission.justification: The requirement explicitly rejects a smaller/moved sentence and a copied tab definition; the chosen compact-control presentation constrains later launcher work without changing launch authority.

alternatives.option: Represent defaults and instruction/mode provenance in controls and hover, with one shared tab visual definition.
alternatives.reason: Keeps the existing launch information and accessible names without the mismatched sentence/titled row.

alternatives.option: Keep the defaults sentence smaller or move it below the controls.
alternatives.reason: Still leaves the sentence the ruled controls-only row removes.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A later approved requirement explicitly calls for a running defaults summary in this surface.

alternatives.option: Copy the tab metrics into a launcher-local recipe.
alternatives.reason: Creates a second visual authority and permits the two surfaces to drift.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A later approved design deliberately separates the launcher and tab visual contracts.

consequences: Mode/instruction/permission information is conveyed by chips and hover; selector names stay accessible.
Provenance and full selected labels survive compact display; launch policy and payloads are unchanged.
Controls may wrap whole with width or excess features; reply prose remains absent.
context: The prior launcher had visible selector titles, a running defaults sentence and a browser-look feature control unlike the cockpit tabs. The developer asked to remove titles, tighten selectors and match the tabs while retaining what the launcher offers and sends.
decider: Developer direction D206, approved MIK-R133@v1 under D47/D48.

evidence: Developer direction D206; MIK-R133@v1 rules1-9 and non-conforming examples (sentence kept smaller/moved, copied tab look); preserved R71 launch authority.
